newsitem.title: UK: Double internet boost for U-Freight customers.
newsitem.headline: Double internet boost for U-Freight customers.

text.p: Hong Kong-based international logistics and freight forwarder U-Freight said it is has upgraded its home page on the Internet and signed up with the Chinese Internet provider, Chinanet.
The upgrade to U-Freight's home page means that customers will now find that the system is more user-friendly as previously unfinished locations have been completed, it said in a statement.
By accessing the system customers will be able to access such things as the shipment tracking facility and see on-line booking airfreight consolidation rates.
The deal with Chinanet will give U-Freight's Chinese customer base important access to on-line cargo tracking and communications services.

"Our interactive home page may have been the first set-up by a global transport company, but unless we maintain out commitment, our position as the market leader in this area will come under pressire," said U-Freight's U.S. managing director Gene Boyer in the statement. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
